Article Title: ‘Erling Haaland leaving Man City one day is inevitable’: Ex-Man City star predicts when striker could push for exit
Article Text:
Manchester City's Erling Haaland warms up prior to the English Premier League soccer match between Manchester City and Bournemouth in Manchester, England, Sunday, Aug. 23, 2026. (AP Photo/Dave Thompson)

Why Haaland could eventually look elsewhere

GOAL

Manchester City's Erling Haaland during the English Premier League soccer match between Manchester City and Bournemouth in Manchester, England, Sunday, Aug. 23, 2026. (AP Photo/Dave Thompson)

The next two years could be crucial

Barry expects Arsenal to be favourites

GOAL

Spain remains a possible destination

Manchester City's Erling Haaland shows his frustration during the English Premier League soccer match between Manchester City and Bournemouth in Manchester, Sunday Aug. 23, 2026. (Nick Potts/PA via AP)

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Erling Haaland's future at Manchester City may be secure for now, but one former City midfielder believes the Norwegian's long-term stay at the Etihad should not be taken for granted.Haaland has committed himself to the club on a contract running until 2034 and remains the centrepiece of City's attack. Yet with the club entering a new era and facing questions over whether it can maintain the dominance of recent seasons, Gareth Barry believes the next couple of years could be decisive in determining whether the prolific striker eventually looks for a new challengeHaaland joined City in 2022 and has already established himself as one of the most prolific goalscorers in the club's history.The 26-year-old has scored 162 goals in 200 appearances across all competitions for City, while playing a major role in a period that included a historic Treble in 2022-23. His long-term contract, signed in 2024, was designed to keep one of football's most coveted strikers at the Etihad well into the next decade.But Barry does not believe the length of that agreement necessarily means Haaland will see it through.Speaking exclusively to, the former England international said: “Erling Haaland leaving Man City one day is inevitable.”Barry stressed that Haaland has no reason to force an exit while City remain competitive, and expects the striker to avoid the kind of public agitation that has accompanied some high-profile transfers.“As much as Haaland's association with City is really big, and that will keep him there for now, he won't be rocking the boat like you see a lot of other players doing,” Barry said.The former City player believes the situation could change if the club's trophy haul begins to decline.“I think if City's dominance does wane a little bit and the trophies aren't coming in, it will fuel the speculation,” he explained. “It is natural sometimes to want a new challenge, and I'm sure Haaland will be no different.”Barry's prediction is therefore less about Haaland wanting out immediately and more about what happens around him.“It's not just going to happen overnight. Haaland will think about his career, which is short,” he said. “But if the trophies aren't coming in, it will just fuel speculation.”And given Haaland's standing in the game, Barry expects the striker to have no shortage of options if he eventually decides the time is right.“He will have offers from all over the world because he's the best striker in the world, so it's just natural. It's one you can see happening in the future.”For Barry, the most important period may not be the end of Haaland's current contract but the next two seasons.He believes the striker's eventual decision will be heavily influenced by how competitive City remain domestically and in Europe.“A lot will depend on how competitive City are in Europe and the Premier League in the next year or two, I should imagine,” Barry said.That is particularly significant given the changes taking place around Haaland.Pep Guardiola has departed after his long spell in charge, while City are now entering a new era under Enzo Maresca. At the same time, Rodri has left, removing one of the most influential players from the team's midfield.Those developments have led Barry to question whether City can immediately return to the top of the Premier League.City have gone two seasons without winning the Premier League, with Liverpool and then Arsenal restoring themselves to the top of the domestic game.Barry, who helped City win their first Premier League title in 2011-12, believes the latest changes could make a title challenge even more difficult.“Even before selling Rodri, given the turnover of managers at City, it would have been tough to overturn Arsenal from where they are at the moment,” he told“I think with Rodri going, they're even less of a threat now to challenge Arsenal.”Barry expects City to strengthen further and believes new additions could ease the burden on Elliot Anderson and the rest of the midfield, but he does not think that will necessarily be enough to make them favourites.“I'm sure they're going to sign one or two to improve and maybe replace him, which will help [Elliot] Anderson and the other players in that midfield,” he said. “I'd say they have less of a chance to challenge and maybe win the title now Rodri is gone. I won't say they've given the title away, but it’s making it a lot harder.”His assessment of the title race is emphatic.“I have Arsenal down as huge favourites,” Barry said. “I just feel with City, with what's going on, the threat is less and less this season and Rodri leaving has just added to that, really. So I can see the other clubs improving.”He also expects Chelsea to progress after missing out on Champions League football, while believing Manchester United and Aston Villa could find European competition challenging.Ultimately, Barry still expects City to finish second but sees a sizeable gap between them and Arsenal.“I still think City will possibly be in second place, but they'll be less of a threat than they were last year,” he said.Haaland's future has already been linked with the two biggest clubs in Spain.Real Madrid's long-standing pursuit of elite attacking talent means the Norwegian continues to be associated with a potential move to the Santiago Bernabéu, while Barcelona are also expected to consider options for the No. 9 position as they plan for life beyond Robert Lewandowski.Those links have existed since Haaland established himself as one of Europe's premier strikers and could become increasingly prominent if City's competitive level drops.A move to Madrid was even part of the platform of former Real Madrid presidential candidate Enrique Riquelme, who promised to sign Haaland had he won the club's election.He did not, leaving the situation unchanged for now.There is no indication that Haaland is currently pushing to leave City, and his enormous contract gives the club significant security. But Barry's argument is that circumstances, rather than the contract itself, could ultimately determine the striker's next move.If City continue challenging for major honours, there may be little reason for Haaland to look elsewhere. If that dominance begins to disappear, however, the equation changes.For a striker who has already achieved extraordinary numbers at the Etihad and who is entering what should be the prime years of his career, the next two seasons could tell City, and Haaland, whether the future is still in Manchester.
Article Summary: Gareth barry believes erling haaland will eventually leave manchester city. The norwegian striker has signed a contract until 2034 at the etihad. Barry believes the next two years could be decisive in determining haaland's future. The former england international expects arsenal to be favourites.

Article Title: 'People don't believe me': Ishan Kishan on his love for red-ball cricket
Article Text:
Ishan Kishan (BCCI Photo)

Kishan on his four-run dismissal

Anukul Roy's five-for seals a big win

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

'We'll have to be on our toes'

NEW DELHI: When Ishan Kishan walks out to bat, the image that usually comes to mind is that of a left-handed batter hitting big sixes, playing brutal pull shots and putting bowlers under pressure. Kishan is known for his aggressive style in white-ball cricket. But on Tuesday, the 28-year-old made it clear that he also loves the challenge of red-ball cricket.The East Zone captain led his team to a massive innings and 210-run win over North East Zone at the BCCI Centre of Excellence Ground 2 in Bengaluru."I enjoy red-ball [cricket] very much. I think people don't believe me when I say that smiles, but it's, I'm being very honest, I really do enjoy red-ball cricket," Kishan told Cricinfo.Kishan has played 32 ODIs and 55 T20Is for India, apart from 134 IPL matches. His last of two Test appearances came in July 2023. Despite his limited opportunities in Test cricket, his love for the red-ball format remains strong."It's always fun to be part of it because I love that challenge when, you know, yes, it's easier to bat on flat tracks and it's fun as well, but the competition which goes around in Test match[es] is some different-level thing," he said.The match against North East Zone was Kishan's 65th first-class appearance. His previous first-class game was against Baroda in the Ranji Trophy in November 2025. In the nine months between the two matches, Kishan played 59 games across international and domestic cricket, including the IPL.As someone who has played plenty of white-ball cricket, he admitted that moving back to the red ball was not easy."Situations will get tricky," he said in Bengaluru, where the Duleep Trophy is being held. "It will not be easy for us as players to just move around from white ball to red ball, red ball to white ball; change of format, change of gameplay, but that is the fun part about this game," Kishan said.He spoke about the pressure and challenges that players deal with away from the field."You need to understand, as a sportsman, life can be harsh on us. It just looks very simple, like [a] player just comes here, plays their matches, and they leave. It's not like that. They go around, they keep on thinking, there's so much going on in their head every time."But Kishan believes players cannot keep making excuses if they want to succeed."If you want to make it big," Kishan said, "you want to make it count, you can't have many excuses. But at the same time, I feel you should just think about getting better and not cry about things which you cannot control."Kishan's innings in the match lasted only four runs. He reached out for a wide ball and tried to guide it behind point before being caught behind.The wicketkeeper-batter admitted that the shot came naturally and he immediately regretted playing it."I was in the middle of the shot, and I was like 'what the heck I was trying to do!' I should know this is [a] Test [first-class] match and I need to leave a few balls. So I was thinking like that, but when you don't practice so much, especially when the red ball is there [things can happen]."Kishan explained how thinking too much about not playing a shot led him to do exactly that."Sometimes when you think about something that you don't want to do, you end up doing it. I did not want to go to the ball and just play. So I ended up doing the same thing because I was thinking like I don't want to do it. I was just attracting those thoughts, which was not meant to happen, but yeah [it happened anyway]."Coming back to the match, East Zone scored 467 in their first innings and then bowled North East Zone out for 111 to enforce the follow-on. North East Zone resumed Tuesday at 7 for 0. According to Kishan, East Zone's spinners were getting turn from the pitch but not much bounce. Anukul Roy picked up a five-wicket haul as North East Zone were bowled out for 146 in 50 overs. The result gave East Zone a massive innings and 210-run victory.The 2026-27 domestic red-ball season has given Kishan a fresh start, but the long break was also visible. Despite the huge victory, Kishan was not happy with East Zone's energy on the field. He wants the team to improve when they face Central Zone in the semi-final, starting on August 30."We played after a very long time, this match, but I feel the energy was not up to the mark," Kishan said, "but it can happen in these matches."When we are going to play the next match, we'll have to be on our toes. We'll have to put effort, we [will] have to fight for each and every wicket. So, we'll look into it. We'll talk, we'll have a meeting, and we'll try and put up a good show in the next game."
Article Summary: Ishan kishan leads east zone to innings and 210-run win over north east zone. The 28-year-old is known for his aggressive style in white-ball cricket. He has played 32 odis and 55 t20is for india, apart from 134 ipl matches. East zone scored 467 in their first innings and then bowled north east zone out for 111 to enforce the follow-on.

Bruno Fernandes has capped a remarkable 2025-26 campaign by being named the PFA Players' Player of the Year, completing a personal clean sweep of the major individual awards after a season in which he rewrote the Premier League's assist record.The Manchester United captain was recognised by his fellow professionals at the PFA Awards in Manchester on Tuesday evening, becoming the first United player to win the prestigious prize since Wayne Rooney in 2010.Fernandes' victory came after he had already been named the Premier League Player of the Season and Football Writers' Association Footballer of the Year, meaning the Portugal international has now collected all three major individual honours available to him for his extraordinary campaign.His 2025-26 season was defined by creativity as much as goals. Fernandes finished with 21 Premier League assists, breaking a record previously shared by Thierry Henry and Kevin De Bruyne, while also scoring nine goals as United secured third place and a return to the Champions League under manager Michael Carrick.But his dominance was not confined to the individual award.Fernandes was also selected in the PFA Premier League Team of the Year, where he was one of only two players from outside Arsenal and Manchester City to make the XI.The other was Brentford striker Igor Thiago.Fernandes' PFA triumph is the latest recognition of a season in which he consistently stood out despite United's struggles in previous campaigns.His record-breaking assist tally reached 21 on the final day of the Premier League season, when he provided the delivery for Patrick Dorgu's header against Brighton.That moved him beyond the previous joint record of 20 assists held by Henry and De Bruyne and gave Fernandes the outright Premier League record for assists in a single season.He finished the campaign with nine goals as United climbed to third in the table, securing Champions League qualification.The PFA award carries a particular significance because it is voted for by fellow professional footballers.Fernandes, who attended Tuesday night's ceremony with his wife Ana, admitted that receiving recognition from players he competes against made the achievement particularly meaningful.“It is obviously a very proud moment,” Fernandes said. “They are the ones you go on the pitch against and it's probably not easy to vote for someone you play against, so it is a very good moment.”His win also restored United's presence at the top of the PFA's individual awards after a 16-year wait. Rooney was the last Manchester United player to win the men's Players' Player of the Year award, taking the honour for the 2009-10 season.Fernandes has also become the first Portuguese Manchester United player to win the award since Cristiano Ronaldo, who claimed the PFA Players' Player of the Year prize in consecutive seasons in 2006-07 and 2007-08 during his time at Old Trafford.Mohamed Salah, who won the award last year, was unable to retain it this time, while no Liverpool player was selected in the Premier League Team of the Year.The composition of the PFA Premier League Team of the Year underlined just how heavily the 2025-26 campaign was shaped by Arsenal and Manchester City.Fernandes was the lone Manchester United representative, while Brentford's Igor Thiago was the only other player from outside those two clubs.Arsenal supplied five players to the XI, with goalkeeper David Raya joined by defenders William Saliba, Gabriel Magalhães and Jurriën Timber, while Declan Rice was selected in midfield.Manchester City also had four representatives: Nico O'Reilly, Rayan Cherki, Antoine Semenyo and Erling Haaland.The completed XI therefore contained:The PFA Team of the Year is effectively the players' all-star XI for the Premier League season, with professionals voting to select the best performers across the campaign.For Fernandes, being included alongside such a dominant Arsenal and City contingent further emphasised the scale of his individual season.Manchester City's Nico O'Reilly had an equally memorable night after being named PFA Men's Young Player of the Year.O'Reilly beat a shortlist that included his City team-mate Rayan Cherki, Arsenal teenager Max Dowman, Junior Kroupi, Manchester United's Kobbie Mainoo and Liverpool youngster Rio Ngumoha.His campaign extended beyond club football, with O'Reilly also helping England finish with a bronze medal at the World Cup.Reflecting on his season, O'Reilly said:“I had a great season. I'm very proud of the season I had. I won two trophies with my club and managed to play at the World Cup with my country. I'm over the moon how it turned out.”O'Reilly's award also complemented his inclusion in the senior PFA Team of the Year, making him one of the night's standout individual winners.Manchester City's Bunny Shaw claimed the PFA Women's Players' Player of the Year for the second time.Shaw had previously won the award in 2024 and now joins an exclusive group of players to have collected the women's prize twice.Only Lucy Bronze, who won in 2014 and 2017, and Fran Kirby, who won in 2018 and 2021, had previously achieved that feat.Shaw's latest victory followed another outstanding season in front of goal.The Manchester City striker scored 21 goals in 22 Women's Super League appearances, winning the WSL Golden Boot and helping City claim their first top-flight title in 10 years.Shaw was also selected in the PFA Women's Team of the Year.
Article Summary: Fernandes completes the individual-award hat-trick with his pfa players player of the year award. Manchester united's fernandes is the first player to win the award three times. Manchester united captain bruno fernandes named pfa players' player of the year. Nico o'reilly wins young player award for a second time.

Article Title: Watch: Al Nassr complete UNBELIEVABLE 3-2 comeback with just 10 men after Ronaldo and goalkeeper forced off
Article Text:
Cristiano Ronaldo watches on as 10-man Al Nassr produce stunning comeback against Al Ettifaq

Everything went wrong for Al Nassr early

Ronaldo comes off as Al Nassr gamble on the comeback

João Félix and Mané turn the game around

Mané completes the unbelievable turnaround

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

A perfect start for Al Nassr

Al Nassr looked destined for a frustrating night after losing their goalkeeper to a straight red card inside 12 minutes, falling 2-0 behind before half-time and then losing Cristiano Ronaldo at the break.Instead, they somehow turned the game completely on its head.Sadio Mané scored twice and João Félix played a central role in the comeback as Al Nassr overturned the deficit to beat Al Ettifaq 3-2 away from home, maintaining their perfect start to the Saudi Roshn League season after three rounds.It was the kind of game that seemed to have slipped away from them long before the final whistle. Somehow, they kept finding a way back.Al Nassr had started positively, but their entire game plan was thrown into chaos in the 12th minute.Bento rushed out of his goal to deal with Moussa Dembélé, but brought the Al Ettifaq forward down outside the penalty area. The referee immediately produced a straight red card, leaving Al Nassr with 10 men for almost the entire match.With no choice but to reorganise, Al Nassr brought on young goalkeeper Abdulrahman Al Otaibi to replace winger Ángelo Gabriel, sacrificing an attacking player simply to fill the vacant position between the posts.That was already a huge problem. The next one was putting the ball in the net.Al Ettifaq began to take advantage of the numerical superiority and eventually broke through in the 31st minute. Ondrej Duda collected the ball around the edge of the area and fired into the top corner, putting the hosts 1-0 ahead.Al Nassr survived until the final moments of the half, but then conceded again.In the third minute of stoppage time, Álvaro Medrán received a pass from Yasser Al-Shammari and unleashed a powerful effort from outside the box. The ball went through Al Otaibi's hands and into the net, leaving Al Nassr 2-0 down at the interval.At that point, the visitors had a man fewer, a two-goal deficit and a makeshift goalkeeper.Then came another major change.Cristiano Ronaldo was replaced at half-time by Abdullah Al-Khaibari, with Al Nassr prioritising defensive balance after Bento's dismissal.That meant the responsibility for finding a way back increasingly fell on Sadio Mané and João Félix.And they nearly got the comeback started early in the second half.In the 53rd minute, Iñigo Martínez came within inches of reducing the deficit when his effort struck the post. João Félix then tested the Al Ettifaq goalkeeper, who managed to keep the Portuguese forward's effort out.Al Nassr were still alive, but they needed something special.They eventually got it in the 74th minute.Félix picked up the ball and threaded a perfectly weighted pass through to Mané, who burst into the box and found himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper.The Senegal international stayed composed and drilled a right-footed finish into the far corner.Suddenly it was 2-1.And Al Nassr were not finished.Just three minutes later, Félix delivered again, this time from a corner. His cross found Abdulelah Al-Amri, who rose to head the ball home from close range.Two goals in three minutes had completely transformed the match.From 2-0 down and a man short, Al Nassr had somehow dragged themselves level.The hosts' goalkeeper then kept Al Ettifaq alive by saving from Mané in the 82nd minute, while Al Nassr continued to push forward despite their numerical disadvantage.The visitors even had two late offside calls go against them in the 89th and 90th minutes.But there was still time for one final attack.With the game entering the 90th minute, Sami Al-Najei drove Al Nassr forward on a rapid counter-attack.He eventually slipped the ball into Mané's path in the middle of the box.Mané did the rest.The forward fired past the goalkeeper to complete his brace and put Al Nassr 3-2 ahead.Al Ettifaq had led by two goals. Al Nassr had been reduced to 10 men in the 12th minute. Ronaldo had then been substituted at half-time.None of it mattered in the end.The final whistle confirmed one of the most dramatic comebacks of the early Saudi Roshn League season.The victory moved Al Nassr onto nine points from their opening three matches, temporarily putting them at the top of the table.Al Ettifaq, meanwhile, remained on six points in sixth place.For Al Nassr, though, the significance of the result goes beyond the table. They had to spend almost the entire match with 10 men, lost their starting goalkeeper, conceded twice before half-time and then continued without Ronaldo after the interval.Yet Mané, Félix and the rest of the team refused to let the game go.Félix supplied the decisive creativity, Al-Amri provided the equaliser and Mané produced the finishing touch, twice.It was supposed to be the night Al Nassr ran out of answers.Instead, they found three.
Article Summary: Al nassr lost their goalkeeper to a straight red card in the 12th minute. Cristiano ronaldo was then sent off for al ettifaq in the 31st minute. Al nassr were 2-0 down before half-time and had a makeshift goalkeeper. Sadio mané and joão félix scored twice in the second half to turn the game around.

Article Title: How Prasidh Krishna became Shubman Gill’s go-to man
Article Text:
Shubman Gill, left, and Prasidh Krishna on day three of the second Test cricket match between India and Sri Lanka, in Colombo, Sri Lanka. (PTI Photo)

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

MUMBAI: Another impressive outing by Prasidh Krishna , who returned figures of 3-47 in 14 overs on a day when Sri Lanka’s batters showed plenty of resolve before rain halted play, emerged as one of India’s biggest positives on Day Three of the second Test at SSC.The tall pacer used the short ball effectively to dismiss Kamil Mishara and Kamindu Mendis, underlining his growing stature in India’s pace attack.Krishna’s journey to becoming a dependable Test bowler can be traced back to two formative stints during his teenage years.In 2016, as part of the IDBI Federal Bowling Foundation, he travelled to Australia with Tushar Deshpande and other young pacers to train under Australian fast-bowling great Jeff Thomson at Cricket Australia’s Centre of Excellence in Brisbane.Former cricket administrator Dr Makarand Waingankar believes the exposure played a significant role in Krishna’s development. “They trained under Thomson, Greg Chappell and Michael Kasprowicz. That exposure stood Prasidh in good stead and helped improve his skills,” Waingankar told TOI.A year later, Krishna joined the MRF Pace Foundation in Chennai, where he honed his craft under legendary Australian quick Glenn McGrath.Over the years, McGrath and Brett Lee have both spoken highly of the Karnataka pacer, reinforcing the belief that he possessed the attributes needed to succeed at the highest level.One of Krishna’s biggest strengths today is his ability to combine steep bounce with a sharp leg-cutter and a well-disguised wobble-seam delivery. MRF Pace Foundation chief coach M Senthilnathan feels those qualities have helped him evolve into a bowler capable of making an impact whenever India need a breakthrough.“We always felt he had the potential to play at the highest level. Slowly, Krishna is turning into a spearhead of the Indian team and cementing his place. The most important thing is that he picks up wickets whenever he comes into the attack and breaks partnerships,” Senthilnathan said.The coach believes regular opportunities at the international level have accelerated Krishna’s growth. “The more fast bowlers play, the more confident they become. Now he feels that he belongs in the Indian team. The management has given him the confidence and they have seen that there is something special in him after all.”Senthilnathan highlighted Krishna’s height, pace and ability to strike at crucial moments as hallmarks of a mature fast bowler. “He has extra bounce, good speed and gets breakthroughs exactly when India want them. Those are signs that he is maturing and becoming a strike bowler.”While India captain Shubman Gill recently described this as the best version of Krishna, his former coach believes there is still more to come. According to Senthilnathan, Krishna is learning how to use the short ball to create pressure before finishing batters off with fuller deliveries, an important skill for a modern Test pacer.Krishna’s rise is all the more remarkable considering the serious back injury that once threatened to derail his career. The injury required surgery and kept him out of the game for an extended period. Now 30, however, the fast bowler looks fitter, stronger and more assured.“He has learnt how to take care of his body and what it takes to have a long career. He understands his workload and follows the right strengthening programmes,” Senthilnathan said.Standing 6ft 4in, Krishna’s height remains a significant asset, allowing him to extract awkward bounce. With confidence growing, fitness concerns behind him and the backing of the team management, the Karnataka pacer increasingly looks like the strike bowler India believe he can become.
Article Summary: Prasidh krishna returned figures of 3-47 in 14 overs on day three of the second test. The tall pacer used the short ball effectively to dismiss kamil mishara and kamindu mendis. Krishna’s journey to becoming a dependable test bowler can be traced back to two formative stints during his teenage years.

Article Title: Stephen Curry and Ayesha Curry make a major $29.1 million move as retirement rumors continue to swirl
Article Text:
Stephen Curry makes a decision.(Image via Getty Images)

Stephen Curry and Ayesha Curry sell their palatial home ahead of the new season raising eyebrows among many

Is Stephen Curry coming back in the next season to announce his retirement?

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Stephen Curry, the four time NBA champion, has been reeling from an injury plagued season as he spends his time in recovery. Ahead of the new season, it seems Stephen Curry and his wife, Ayesha Curry, have made a multi million dollar move.According to reports, the Golden State Warriors’ star player Stephen Curry and his wife Ayesha Curry sold their palatial Bay Area mansion at 28 Selby Lane for a whopping $29.1 million.The off market transaction seems to have been made in May as Stephen Curry and Ayesha Curry moved out of the affluent town.Earlier in 2021, Stephen Curry and his wife Ayesha Curry sold another luxurious property in Atherton for a whopping $31.2 million.For the unversed, Stephen Curry and his wife, Ayesha Curry, had bought their recently sold home in 2020 for $30 million. Selling it at $29 million seems like a huge loss for the star player but it has not been made clear what prompted him to make such a move.This 17,761 square feet luxurious home is in Atherton's Redwood Oaks neighborhood which is considered to be one of the richest neighborhoods across the nation.The luxurious home has seven bedrooms, eight and a half bathrooms, separate guest house, walnut orchard, resort-style swimming pool and cabana, a private wine cellar, and expansive indoor living areas.However, neither the Golden State Warriors' star player Stephen Curry nor his wife Ayesha Curry has reacted to the news yet as they remain private about their finances.Ahead of the new season, there have been a lot of speculations about it being the last season for Stephen Curry before he announces his retirement.A few weeks ago, NBA insider Brett Siegel had weighed in on Stephen Curry’s retirement rumors as he said, "In terms of what his future with the Warriors looks like, Curry is not going anywhere anytime soon.”NBA insider Brett Siegel added, "Retirement is obviously on the horizon, but team sources told ClutchPoints that Curry has made it known multiple times throughout the years that he would like to play at least 20 seasons in the NBA. Article Title: Merrill Kelly accuses Cubs coach Quintin Berry of sign stealing, calls move ‘bush league’ after heated clash
Article Text:
Merrill Kelly accuses Cubs coach Quintin Berry of sign stealing, calls move ‘bush league’ after heated clash

Merrill Kelly calls out Quintin Berry over sign-stealing accusation

Craig Counsell responds as Cubs beat Diamondbacks

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Arizona Diamondbacks pitcher Merrill Kelly accused Chicago Cubs third-base coach Quintin Berry of stealing and relaying signs during Monday night’s 7-0 loss at Chase Field. Kelly said Berry appeared to have picked up something about his changeup and was passing that information to Cubs hitters, particularly left-handed batters. The accusation led to a heated exchange between the two dugouts in the fifth inning. After the game, Kelly made his view clear, saying sign stealing is part of baseball when players do it, but called it “a little bush league” when a coach is involved. MLB also reported the incident.The issue came up in the fifth inning when Kelly was pitching to Michael Busch with runners on base. Kelly stepped off the mound and looked toward Berry, who was standing in the Cubs’ third-base coaching box. The two benches then started shouting at each other as the Diamondbacks questioned whether Berry was picking up Kelly’s signs.Kelly later explained what Arizona believed was happening. He said the Diamondbacks thought Berry had noticed something about his changeup and was relaying it to Chicago’s hitters.“Stealing signs is as old as baseball,” Kelly said. “I think it’s a little bull**** when it comes from a coach.“I think if it’s a guy on second base and they see the grip in your glove or if the hitters can see something that you’re doing with your glove, I think that’s fair game.“I think guys have been doing that since the beginning of baseball.“I think it’s a little bush league when it comes from outside that.”Kelly did not say that stealing signs itself was wrong. Instead, he drew a line between what players can notice during a game and what he believes coaches should be doing from outside the field.The tension did not end when the fifth inning was over. Kelly was removed after allowing a two-out single in the sixth and appeared to stare toward Berry and the Cubs’ bench as he walked away.Diamondbacks manager Torey Lovullo had already stepped onto the mound earlier to settle things down and give Kelly a chance to finish the inning.Cubs manager Craig Counsell did not treat the incident as a major issue. After the game, he described it simply as “gamesmanship that goes on every day in the league.”Kelly also accepted that he needs to look at his own pitching. If Berry really noticed something, Kelly said, other teams could potentially notice it too.“That being said, I gotta take a look at what I’m doing, because clearly he had something. And obviously if he has it, then other people would probably pick up on it as well. I gotta figure out and do better on my part to not give it away. But yeah, I think it should stay between the players.”The Cubs finished the night with a 7-0 win, while Kelly gave up three earned runs over 5⅔ innings. The accusation now adds another layer to an already important late-season series between two teams fighting for a postseason spot.
Article Summary: Merrill kelly accuses cubs coach quintin berry of sign stealing, calls move ‘bush league’ after heated clash. Kelly said berry appeared to have picked up something about his changeup and was passing that information to cubs hitters. Article Title: How bad is the NFL's CTE problem? A new study just answered that and it's grim
Article Text:
cte nfl research (Getty Images)

What does the new CTE study actually say about NFL players?

1 in 4 NFL players or more developed brain disease CTE (Getty Images)

Does the NFL's kickoff rule change make the CTE problem worse?

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

A study published Tuesday in the British Medical Journal has put a number to what many in football have long feared. At least one in four NFL players who died between 2016 and 2021 had chronic traumatic encephalopathy, the degenerative brain disease better known as CTE. The research, led by scientists from Harvard Medical School, Massachusetts General Hospital, and Boston University, focused on 878 former NFL players who died in that six-year period. Of that group, at least 215 of them, or 24.5 percent, had CTE. And here is the part that should make the NFL uncomfortable: researchers say that 25 percent figure is likely the floor, not the ceiling.The estimate of 25 percent is on the "low end," said Dr. Daniel Daneshvar, the study's lead author. The study found that the maximum possible prevalence of CTE was around 97 percent, but the true rate "is somewhere in the middle," Daneshvar said.That range between 25 and 97 percent sounds staggeringly wide, but it reflects a core limitation of CTE research: the disease can only be confirmed in dead tissue. CTE can be diagnosed only after death, so most research has depended on brains donated by players or their families.Of the 878 players in the sample, only 338 actually had their brains examined. The remaining 643 were never studied. Daneshvar's team ran statistical models to estimate what that missing data might look like, which is why the range is so broad.Jesse Mez, a BU CTE Center codirector of clinical research, put it plainly: "If at least 25 percent of NFL players who died had these changes in their brain, then this seems like a call to action for more discussion about risk, more research, and more support for affected families."When applied to active players, that would mean about 400 of the current 1,696 active players could develop CTE. That is not a projection the NFL or the NFLPA can easily dismiss. The NFLPA said in a statement: "This study is a sobering reminder that football carries real risks, and those risks can have lasting consequences for players and their families. The findings should serve as a call to action across the entire football ecosystem. "The timing of this study lands in the middle of a live debate inside the league. When the touchback changed to the 35 and teams became incentivized to put more kickoffs in play, concussions spiked. Specifically for the player returning the kick and the player tackling him.That matters because the new BMJ study adds statistical pressure to what some team officials have already been saying privately. As one source put it, it was "the elephant in the room" at the annual league meetings in March. Moving the touchback line from the 30 to the 35 brought more returns, more collisions, and more concussions. Those concussions, accumulated over careers, are precisely what researchers link to CTE development.There is now a camp inside the league that wants the touchback point moved back to the 30. The new study will cause the opponents of the 35-yard touchback point to argue even more loudly that it should return to the 30.There is also an important caveat worth noting. The average age of the former players whose brains were donated was around 66 years old, meaning most of their professional football careers took place before 2005, when CTE was first diagnosed in a former NFL player. One researcher noted this "may not represent the NFL in 2026," given the rule changes and safety improvements made since then. That is a reasonable qualifier. But it does not make the numbers disappear.The NFL has spent years managing this conversation carefully. This study, peer-reviewed and published in one of medicine's most respected journals, makes that harder.
Article Summary: Study: at least one in four nfl players who died between 2016 and 2021 had cte. Researchers say that 25 percent figure is likely the floor, not the ceiling. The maximum possible prevalence of cte was around 97 percent, but the true rate "is somewhere in the middle"

Article Title: Tom Brady embraces a new side of himself with Gucci as Dave Portnoy pokes fun at his unexpected fashion turn
Article Text:
Tom Brady steps into his bold new Gucci fashion era(Getty Images)

Dave Portnoy wastes no time teasing Tom Brady over his bold Gucci transformation

Tom Brady says stepping outside football led him to discover a surprising love for leather

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Tom Brady is showing fans a side of himself they rarely see. At 49, the seven-time Super Bowl champion has stepped into the fashion world as the face of a new Gucci campaign, trading his familiar football and broadcasting style for bold leather looks. His transformation quickly caught the attention of Barstool Sports founder Dave Portnoy, who jokingly questioned Brady’s new image online. While the trolling added some humor to the moment, Brady appears to be genuinely enjoying the experience and has even developed a surprising appreciation for leather.Brady’s Gucci campaign features two very different looks, both far removed from the polished suits fans usually see him wearing during his Fox Sports broadcasts.One outfit features a dark gray and sage-green satin double-breasted jacket with wide peak lapels and matching trousers. Brady wore the jacket without a shirt, giving the look a much more relaxed and fashion-focused feel. A silver cuff bracelet and dark shoes completed the outfit.The second look went even further. Brady appeared in a black leather jacket with broad lapels and structured shoulders, paired with matching leather pants and pointed boots.That particular look gave Portnoy an opening to have some fun. After GQ’s interview with Brady was shared by OK! Magazine, Portnoy quote-tweeted the post with a short message aimed at the former quarterback.“BLINK TWICE IF YOU NEED HELP TOMMY!”The joke quickly added a sports-world perspective to Brady’s fashion moment. Portnoy’s reaction was playful, but it also highlighted just how unusual it is to see one of football’s most recognizable figures embracing such a different style.Brady, however, appears to be enjoying the change rather than taking himself too seriously.The Gucci campaign is not Brady’s first major step into fashion this year. In May, he made his runway debut during Gucci’s Cruise 2027 show in Times Square, marking a major change from the world he dominated for more than two decades.Interestingly, Brady said he did not have a close relationship with Gucci before the opportunity arrived. The initial phone call caught him off guard, but curiosity eventually replaced the surprise.“Not much, ironically, so it was a fun phone call,” Brady said about his previous connection with Gucci. “At first, there was a bit of like, ‘Wait, say that again?’”For Brady, the appeal was not simply about wearing expensive clothes or appearing in a major campaign. He viewed the experience as a chance to try something completely unfamiliar.“You have these once-in-a-lifetime opportunities, and that's how I saw it,” he said.The former quarterback also discovered that leather was more comfortable than he expected. His Gucci experience has even changed what he keeps in his own closet.“I’d never really done leather on leather before, but there are some leather pants in my closet now,” Brady told GQ. “I thought, ‘Damn, that’s actually really comfortable.’ I could see why people wear this.”Brady has not committed to becoming a full-time model, but he has left the door open for more fashion work.“I would never say never to doing anything,” Brady said.His reasoning fits the mindset that defined much of his football career. For Brady, trying something new is part of continuing to grow, even when it means stepping far outside familiar territory.“I always say the only place for growth is outside your comfort zone,” Brady said.
Article Summary: Tom brady has stepped into the fashion world as the face of a new gucci campaign. Barstool sports founder dave portnoy jokingly questioned brady’s new image online. Brady appears to be genuinely enjoying the experience and has even developed a surprising appreciation for leather.

Article Title: “What has the world come to”: 11-year NBA legend’s WNBA arena ban stirs the pot again amid trans athlete debate
Article Text:
Enes Kanter Freedom. Image via: Joseph Weiser/ Getty Images

Enes Kanter Freedom faces first WNBA arena ban

Chicago Sky arena ban sparks intense reaction

Stephen A. Smith responds to Enes Kanter Freedom's campaign

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Enes Kanter Freedom wanted a seat at the table in women's basketball. Instead, he got escorted out of one and banned from ever walking back through the doors.The former NBA center, who has said he now identifies as a woman for the purpose of entering the WNBA draft, was ejected from a Chicago Sky game on Sunday after a heated exchange with guard Natasha Cloud. Two days later, Sky owner Michael Alter made it official: Freedom is no longer welcome at Wintrust Arena.Alter said the club would only reconsider "if he's able to prove to us he's able to abide by our rules." That single line drew the hardest boundary of the whole saga: not a suspension, not a warning, but an outright ban from the building.The trouble started late in the third quarter of Sunday's loss to the Indiana Fever. Freedom was sitting baseline in a shirt reading "WOMAN noun. adult human female."Cloud, fresh off a bucket and a chest bump with teammate Aicha Coulibaly, walked straight at him, yelling and pointing. Freedom stood, held his arms out, and stepped onto the court before security and several Sky players moved between them. Nobody threw a punch. Security still walked him out.On his way through the lobby, Freedom spun around, held his shirt out toward the crowd, and talked to a group of police officers before he left the building.He later posted on social media that he'd been "kicked out of a WNBA game for supporting WOMEN."The league itself had reportedly planned to let the incident pass without punishment, since Freedom never actually stepped onto the playing surface. Alter clearly saw it differently. Freedom and fellow former NBA player Royce White have both declared for the WNBA draft on the same grounds, though a person familiar with the league's thinking told the AP that neither is considered eligible. The WNBA's collective bargaining agreement restricts the league to women but stops short of defining gender identity or sex assigned at birth, which is exactly the loophole both men say they're testing.Social media did what social media does. One fan summed up the mood with a simple "What has the world come to 😂."Others leaned into mockery: "Now he can go back to begging the boys at the rec center to choose him for a pickup game." A few pushed back on the framing entirely, insisting "she wasn't the one who started it" and demanding people "let her play."Stephen A. Smith weighed in with his usual mix of sympathy and scolding. He credited Freedom's history of standing up to the Turkish government but said stepping toward Cloud was "excessive," adding that the WNBA players themselves "don't deserve" to be caught in the middle of a fight that belongs with the league, not the roster.“It was a classless thing for him to do because it's not the ladies that are playing don't have anything to do with this. The league does. It's collective bargaining agreement may be the case. The liberal tilt that it has might be a cause or a cause effect to some degree. I get all of that,” Smith shared.He added, “But the actual ladies that are involved, they have nothing to do with this and they don't deserve to be agitated the way he clearly was willing to do in attendance at the game.”Freedom hasn't backed off. If anything, the ban gives him one more grievance to fold into a draft campaign that was already built on confrontation. Whether the WNBA rules him eligible or not, Wintrust Arena is now off limits either way.
Article Summary: Enes kanter freedom was ejected from a chicago sky game on sunday after a heated exchange with guard natasha cloud. Two days later, sky owner michael alter made it official: freedom is no longer welcome at wintrust arena. The former nba center has said he now identifies as a woman for the purpose of entering the wnba draft.

Article Title: Is Mike Vrabel missing Stefon Diggs - New England Patriots coach’s “not very deep” comment raises questions about AJ Brown’s importance
Article Text:
Is Mike Vrabel missing Stefon Diggs - New England Patriots coach’s “not very deep” comment reportedly raises questions about AJ Brown’s importance (Image via Getty: Mike Vrabel​)

Mike Vrabel reveals the New England Patriots don’t have a very deep team

Patriots’ lack of depth solution

Mike Vrabel clarifies his “not very deep” comment

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

A lot has happened to the New England Patriots.This includes their Super Bowl loss to the Seattle Seahawks in February, and the March-April revelation that head coach Mike Vrabel was reportedly photographed with former NFL reporter Dianna Russini at an adults-only hotel in Sedona, Arizona. Those were not the only disasters.The Patriots also lost Stefon Diggs , the explosive 1,000-yard wide receiver who energized the locker room and the field.The team apparently cut him because of off-field legal issues, despite signing him for three seasons. Then came the famous trade that brought veteran wideout A.J. Brown from the Philadelphia Eagles to the Patriots, an idea seemingly ignited by Dianna Russini.If all that wasn’t enough for the coach to lose faith and say something like, “we’re not a very deep team”, what else could be?Mike Vrabel’s recent comment about the team reportedly raises questions about Brown’s importance. It might even make people wonder if the coach misses his fiery player from the 2025 season, Stefon Diggs.At a recent New England Patriots press conference, a reporter asked whether quarterback Drake Maye, A.J. Brown, and the other starters would play in the final preseason game, or whether the joint practices they’d had were enough preparation for the upcoming season and meant they didn’t need to play in the preseason.The Patriots head coach, Mike Vrabel, replied:“I don’t think we have a very deep team, Mike, so, you know, I think we have to make sure that we’re preparing our football team and that we’re doing everything that we can to keep our best players available.And if that means playing Thursday [in New England’s final preseason game] as part of preparation, that’s what we’ll do. Have not made that decision yet, but I would say that that’s something that I’m confident in with where we’re set up currently.”It’s the “don’t have a very deep team” part that stays with you. Is he reportedly not confident enough in A.J. Brown? That he wouldn’t get injured? Would Brown prove to be much, much better than Stefon Diggs? Or is it something else? Just speculations here…CBS Sports’ Bryan DeArdo reports that Mike Vrabel’s direct admission means he is keeping his starters out of preseason games because the Patriots cannot afford to lose any of them, as they do not have the depth necessary to replace them.This could become concerning over the course of the season. Depth is essential for a team to endure the wear and tear of a 17-game regular season.If the Patriots lack depth, they could sign new players who become available at the end of the preseason when teams make their 53-man roster cuts. The Patriots could also trade for players from other teams at any time until November 10, 2026.The best option would also be for Mike Vrabel and the other coaches to train their backups, who currently make up the roster.“We are the front office. We’re all included in this,” Vrabel said on WEEI-FM radio. “I can walk it [‘not very deep comment’] back; I’ve already talked to [vice president of player personnel] Eliot [Wolf] this morning…I’m not into subtle comments.”“When you look at how you want to be constructed, we have to continue to draft very well,” the head coach said.“We have to continue to develop those late-round picks, the guys you can find who can be interior offensive linemen, who can be special teams linebackers…some edge guys you can develop. I think we can always work to improve that.”The Patriots lost starting interior offensive lineman Garrett Bradbury to the Chicago Bears this offseason.They also lost edge rusher K’Lavon Chaisson to the Washington Commanders, where he will reunite with Stefon Diggs. The Patriots also released special teams linebackers Jahlani Tavai and Anfernee Jennings this offseason.The coach clarified that he is not talking about wide receivers; he is not talking about A.J. Brown or missing Stefon Diggs. It’s the late-round picks that need development, interior offensive linemen, special teams linebackers, and some edge rushers too.The coach lost Super Bowl-reaching team members this offseason; he is bound to feel a little bit “not very deep.” It doesn’t mean he is missing former players. He just wants to strengthen his backup army.But then the Patriots just traded wide receiver Kayshon Boutte to the Houston Texans for a safety - for Jaylen Reed. What is happening in New England? Is the wide receiver room depth really too much of a concern right now?There are concerns about A.J. Brown’s injury too. The Patriots will have to be careful with the star veteran wide receiver. He almost had two injuries in August practice - a thumb injury and an awkward misstep.But again, the coach is not missing Stefon Diggs! So we shall all move on from that…
Article Summary: Mike vrabel reportedly said the new england patriots don’t have a ‘very deep team’ the comment reportedly raises questions about a.j. Brown’s importance. It might even make people wonder if the coach misses his fiery player from the 2025 season, stefon diggs. The patriots lost starting offensive lineman garrett bradbury to the chicago bears.

Article Title: Islam Makhachev makes bold Alexander Volkanovski prediction as Movsar Evloev prepares for UFC 333 title fight

Islam Makhachev predicts Movsar Evloev can beat Alexander Volkanovski

Alexander Volkanovski reveals what could happen after Movsar Evloev fight

Islam Makhachev has made a clear pick for the Alexander Volkanovski vs. Movsar Evloev title fight, and it may surprise some UFC fans. The UFC welterweight champion believes Evloev’s youth could help him beat Volkanovski at UFC 333. Makhachev also feels the Australian is no longer at the same peak he reached a few years ago, even though he still sees him as one of the best fighters in the sport.Volkanovski and Evloev will meet for the UFC featherweight title on October 24 at Etihad Arena in Abu Dhabi. The UFC has officially confirmed the fight as the main event of UFC 333. Volkanovski enters the bout as champion, while Evloev is still unbeaten with a 20-0 record.Makhachev knows what Volkanovski brings because the two have already fought twice. Their first meeting came at UFC 284, where Makhachev won a close decision. He then stopped Volkanovski with a head kick in the first round of their rematch at UFC 294.Now, despite those wins, Makhachev is not picking his former opponent to keep the featherweight belt.Speaking to reporters in Russia, Makhachev backed Evloev and pointed to the age gap between the two fighters.“It’s no secret and he himself knows that the fight won’t be easy, that Volkanovski is a tough opponent for anyone. But I think Movsar will manage with his youth. Volkanovski, honestly speaking, is not at the same peak he was a couple of years ago. Even though he is still one of the best fighters. I think it’ll be a very competitive fight but I hope Movsar will do his job.”Sherdog reported Makhachev’s prediction on August 25.The prediction is interesting because Makhachev did not dismiss Volkanovski. Instead, he pointed to something that could matter over five rounds: whether the 37-year-old champion can still perform at the level he showed during his best years.Evloev, meanwhile, has built an unbeaten record and earned his first UFC title shot. The UFC’s official event listing identifies him as the No. 1-ranked contender going into the fight.There is another reason this title fight has extra weight for Volkanovski. The champion recently admitted that a very bad performance against Evloev could make him think about retirement.Volkanovski told 10 News that he has no plans to retire right now. However, he said the result and the damage from the fight could affect what he decides next.“If things go terribly wrong, alright, we’re done. If things go very well, like the last one, no damage, go through, alright, we’ll keep it rolling. Taking each fight as it goes, just trying to be real with it. But I don’t have plans on retiring right now. Money’s always good.” MMA Fighting reported his comments.That puts more focus on what happens when Volkanovski faces the undefeated Evloev. Makhachev expects the younger challenger to take advantage, while Volkanovski is preparing to show that he still has enough to stay on top.

Article Title: First in 48 years! Sonal Dinusha joins Zaheer Abbas, Everton Weekes in rare Test feat against India
Article Text:
Sri Lanka's Sonal Dinusha plays a shot on the third day of the second Test. (ANI Photo)

Dinusha's remarkable start against India

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Dinusha frustrates India as lower order digs in

NEW DELHI: Sri Lanka's Sonal Dinusha has entered an elite group of batters after becoming only the third player to score 80 or more in each of his first three Test innings against India, joining West Indies great Everton Weekes and Pakistan legend Zaheer Abbas Dinusha reached the landmark during a stubborn innings on the third day of the second Test in Colombo, remaining unbeaten on 85 as Sri Lanka finished at 265 for eight after rain and bad light forced an early close.The 25-year-old left-hander had already made 100 and 84 in his first two Test innings against India, and his latest effort made him the first batter since Abbas in 1978 to achieve the feat.Abbas had scored 176, 96 and 235 not out in his first three innings against India, while Weekes made 128, 194 and 162 in 1948. Weekes went on to score centuries in each of his first four innings against India before being dismissed for 90 in his fifth.Dinusha's latest innings also gave him a third consecutive 50-plus score against India, making him only the second Sri Lankan batter and 10th overall to achieve that feat in his first three Test innings against the opposition.The only Sri Lankan to previously accomplish it was Duleep Mendis, who scored 105, 105 and 51 in his first three Test innings against India.Dinusha's performance has been particularly striking given his comfort against spin. He has scored 106 runs through sweep shots — including conventional, slog and reverse sweeps — in the ongoing series, the most by a batter against spin in a Test series since ball-by-ball data became available in 2007 for the relevant shots.Joe Root holds the overall record in the category, having scored 160 runs through sweeps against Sri Lanka in 2021. Ben Duckett has 112 against Pakistan in 2022, while Root scored 106 against India in 2021.Dinusha has taken the sweep to another level in his short Test career. Of his 284 runs against spin, 122 — or 42.95 per cent — have come through sweep shots. He has scored those runs at a remarkable strike rate of 169.44, hitting 11 fours and four sixes without being dismissed playing the shot.India appeared to be closing in on Sri Lanka's innings when the hosts resumed after tea at 216 for seven. Instead, Dinusha continued to frustrate the attack for 201 minutes.He first added 57 runs with Keshara Nuwantha for the eighth wicket before putting on an unbeaten 35 with Lahiru Kumara for the ninth. Nuwantha faced 74 deliveries, while Kumara survived for 65 minutes off 50 balls.Earlier, India had claimed four wickets for 86 runs in the middle session after Sri Lanka had added 122 in the morning. Manav Suthar dismissed Dhananjaya de Silva, Ravindra Jadeja removed Pasindu Sooriyabandara for 80 and Mohammed Siraj accounted for Niroshan Dickwella.But Dinusha's resistance ensured Sri Lanka remained alive at 265 for eight, still 238 runs behind India's 503 for nine and 38 runs short of avoiding the follow-on.
Article Summary: Sonal dinusha becomes only the third player to score 80 or more in each of his first three test innings against india. Dinusha reached the landmark during a stubborn innings on the third day of the second test in colombo, remaining unbeaten on 85. Sri lanka finished at 265 for eight after rain and bad light forced an early close.

Article Title: Chad Ochocinco points to Week 3 as Deshaun Watson’s Browns future hangs in balance with Shedeur Sanders
Article Text:
Chad Ochocinco points to Week 3 as Deshaun Watson’s Browns future hangs in balance with Shedeur Sanders

Chad Ochocinco sets a Week 4 warning for Deshaun Watson

Deshaun Watson’s Browns preseason numbers add pressure

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Chad Ochocinco believes Deshaun Watson may have only three games to prove he should remain the Cleveland Browns’ starting quarterback. After head coach Todd Monken named Watson QB1 for Week 1, Ochocinco said on Nightcap that Cleveland could turn to Shedeur Sanders if things go badly early. He pointed specifically to the Browns’ third game, saying a quarterback change could come before Week 4.The Browns will begin the 2026 regular season with Watson against the Jacksonville Jaguars on September 13.Cleveland then travels to face the Tampa Bay Buccaneers before returning home to play the Carolina Panthers in Week 3. That third game is the one Ochocinco believes could become a major test for Watson.Speaking on Nightcap, Ochocinco said he had already expected Watson to get the first chance because of his contract. The quarterback signed a five-year, $230 million fully guaranteed deal with Cleveland in 2022, making the decision a major financial commitment for the Browns.“I said it before preseason started, when they went to training camp, it’s Deshaun Watson’s (starting job) to lose,” Ochocinco said. “So, they’re gonna allow him to start, and they had two games on the road. I’m not sure what’s gonna happen with those two games, hoping he looks the part.But if he doesn’t, that first home game, the third game of the season, if it’s not going well, at that point a change will be made.”He then made his prediction even more direct.“Mark my words, I haven’t been wrong yet. … If the third game does not go the way it should, a change will be made going into Week 4. I’m telling you right now ahead of time.”That would put Shedeur Sanders in the middle of the conversation. The Browns have not said they plan to make such a change, and Monken has stressed that naming Watson the starter was not meant to be a week-to-week decision. NFL.com reported that Watson and Sanders will both sit out Cleveland’s preseason finale against the New England Patriots.Watson’s preseason has not made the situation any easier. Through two games, he has completed 16 of 27 passes for 162 yards, with no touchdowns and one interception.He went 11-for-15 for 126 yards against the Chicago Bears, then completed only 5 of 12 passes for 36 yards and an interception against the Buffalo Bills.The Bills loss also brought boos from Browns fans, adding more attention to Watson’s return. He has played only 19 games for Cleveland since joining the team in 2022 and missed the entire 2025 season after a re-rupture of his right Achilles tendon.For now, Watson remains the Browns’ QB1. But if Ochocinco’s prediction proves right, the Week 3 meeting with Carolina could become much more important than a normal home opener.

The browns will begin the 2026 regular season with watson against the jacksonville jaguars on september 13. Cleveland then travels to face the tampa bay buccaneers before returning home to play the carolina panthers in week 3.

Article Title: Is Darcy Kuemper’s NHL future becoming Los Angeles Kings’ most intriguing question before opening night
Article Text:
Los Angeles Kings goalie Darcy Kuemper skates to the corner during a stoppage in play during the third period of an NHL hockey game against the Vancouver Canucks, in Vancouver, on Tuesday, April 14, 2026. (Darryl Dyck/The Canadian Press via AP)

Could Darcy Kuemper’s future reshape Los Angeles Kings’ NHL plans?

Could Darcy Kuemper trade rumors become more serious?

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

The Los Angeles Kings are entering the 2026-27 NHL season with a question mark at the goaltending position. Darcy Kuemper was the obvious No. 1, but his play dipped in 2025-26 after an injury, and Anton Forsberg played better down the stretch and took the playoff crease. According to the Kings’ own training-camp preview, both veterans could be in the mix for the job, with Erik Portillo possibly in the NHL picture as well.There’s also been some NHL trade speculation surrounding Kuemper. He was mentioned in a recent report as a possible trade candidate, but there’s no indication that Los Angeles Kings general manager Ken Holland is actively shopping him. Kuemper supposedly wants to stay in Los Angeles and fight for his starting spot.Darcy Kuemper’s future could depend on his ability to regain the starting job for the Los Angeles Kings.Kuemper came into 2025-26 off a stellar season in which he posted a 31-11-7 record with a 2.02 goals-against average and .921 save percentage. His numbers dipped considerably in 2025-26, when he posted a 19-14-15 mark, 2.78 GAA and.891 save percentage.Anton Forsberg offers the Los Angeles Kings a real option in net.Forsberg had a 16-12-5 record, a 2.57 goals-against average and a.909 save percentage in 36 regular-season games. He then started all four playoff games against the Colorado Avalanche, adding to his case for a bigger role in 2026-27.That just makes training camp all the more important. The Kings recognise that Forsberg might seek more starts, and Kuemper is eager to regain his form. The organization could even start the season with Kuemper and Forsberg, plus Erik Portillo, all on the NHL roster.The ongoing Darcy Kuemper trade rumours are still speculation and not confirmed trade discussions.The Hockey News listed Kuemper as a trade candidate if his role is reduced, but that doesn’t mean Ken Holland is looking to make a deal. Kuemper wanting to remain with the Los Angeles Kings adds a whole other level to the situation.For now, the most obvious storyline is competition. If Kuemper makes the save, the Kings have little reason to move him. But if Forsberg makes himself the guy, the Kings could have a more difficult roster and salary decision to make.Kuemper will have to show more than improved stats in training camp. He needs to show that his movement, rebounding and consistency have returned after last season’s struggles.If he posts strong numbers in the preseason, it would go a long way toward reassuring the Kings’ coaching staff and his teammates that he can still handle a starter’s workload.The immediate answer should not be trade speculation, but training camp and the opening weeks of the NHL season.
Article Summary: Darcy kuemper's future could depend on his ability to regain the starting job for the los angeles kings. Anton forsberg offers the kings a real option in net. The organization could even start the season with kuemper and forsberg, plus erik portillo, on the nhl roster.
